_meta.purpose: Curated decoder output blocklist. Tokens whose presence in decoder output would violate the hard constraint 'no free-text attack-tooling / exploit-synthesis output' (REQUIREMENTS.lock hard_constraints). Enforced at logit level (p = -inf) before argmax/softmax.
_meta.resolution: Each entry under 'blocked_terms' is resolved to vocabulary token ID(s) via the active tokenizer at load time. Only terms that map to a single vocabulary token are masked (logit masking is inherently per-token). A real security-corpus BPE vocab is expected to carry these as atomic tokens.
_meta.note: This list is intentionally conservative and non-operational: it names tool/payload identifiers to suppress, never how to use them.
